prompt: Of the top five all-time scoring leaders of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA), which players were still playing professionally as of the 2024 season?
answer:
As of the **2024 season**, the players among the top five all-time scorers who were still playing professionally were:

- **LeBron James (NBA)** — No. 1 NBA all-time scorer.
- **Diana Taurasi (WNBA)** — No. 1 WNBA all-time scorer.
- **DeWanna Bonner (WNBA)** — No. 4 WNBA all-time scorer.

The other top-five scorers in each league—Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Tina Charles, Tina Thompson, and Tamika Catchings—were no longer playing in the 2024 season.
